info.name: End to End Data Pipeline API
info.description:
Two data pipelines, one API.

**Path A (ETL):** Scraped articles → cleaned → loaded
**Path B (ELT):** Raw CSV → loaded → SQL transforms

## Setup
1. Set `base_url` variable (default: http://localhost:8000)
2. Run "Get JWT Token" first — it auto-saves the token
3. All protected endpoints use API Key by default
4. Switch to Bearer token in the JWT folder

## Auth Methods
- **API Key:** X-API-Key header
- **JWT Bearer:** POST /token → use access_token

item.name: 4. Attrition (ELT) — API Key

request.description: Overall attrition: total employees, yes/no count, rate.

Attrition rate + avg income per department.
SQL: GROUP BY + FILTER + AVG (from transform_attrition.sql queries 1 & 2).

Attrition rate by overtime status.
SQL: GROUP BY cross-tab (from transform_attrition.sql query 4).

Attrition rate by tenure bucket (new <2y, mid 2-5y, veteran 5y+).
SQL: CASE WHEN (from transform_attrition.sql query 3).

Top N earners per department.
SQL: RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...) window function (from transform_attrition.sql query 5).

item.description:
